near-black.$description: Near Black — Page canvas, card surfaces, filled button backgrounds — the default void everything else floats in

almost-white.$description: Almost White — Primary text, icon strokes, nav labels, and 1px borders — the paper-white that does all the talking against the void

soft-white.$description: Soft White — Section label text in the stamped uppercase style — same family as Almost White but slightly dimmer for hierarchy

steel.$description: Steel — Muted secondary text, inactive button surfaces, subdued borders

graphite.$description: Graphite — Card internal text and subtle dividers — readable on the near-black without competing with the primary text

iron.$description: Iron — Dark borders and separators for elevated surfaces and inverted UI. Do not promote it to the primary CTA color

ash.$description: Ash — Nav border dividers, helper text, low-emphasis body copy

signal-violet.$description: Signal Violet — The only chromatic voice: feature card glow, primary action fill, and accent strokes — rationed like runway lighting, not decoration

lavender-mist.$description: Lavender Mist — Soft tint paired with Signal Violet for contrast-safe text and washed background accents

whyte-inktrap.$description: Primary workhorse — body, nav, buttons, links, and most headings. The inktrap corners (the tiny cuts where straight strokes meet) are the signature; they give the geometry warmth without losing precision. Weight 300 carries the larger sizes and creates the editorial lightness that pairs with the GrandSlang italic.

whyte-inktrap-mono.$description: The stamped-letterhead voice: 74px uppercase sections like 'SSL INSPECTION' and 'URL FILTERING' with 0.2em tracking. The mono is intentionally mechanical against the humanist Whyte to create the boarding-pass rhythm. This font does the section signposting.

grandslang.$description: The italic display serif reserved for the hero and its echoes — 'Your new', 'with AI DLP'. Its warm brush-italic swells make the brand feel human and confident where the rest of the system is clinical. This is the one font that should never be used for body or nav.

system-ui.$description: system-ui — detected in extracted data but not described by AI

karla.$description: Karla — detected in extracted data but not described by AI
